title: Crispy Garlic Parmesan Fries
steps: Preheat oven to 220Preheat oven to 220C.
Toss potato fries with olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Bake for 20 minutes until golden and crispy.
Toss immediately with minced garlic and grated parmesan cheese.
author: Subash Chef

title: Creamy Tuscan Garlic Chicken
ingredients: Salt and black pepper to taste
steps: Season chicken with salt, pepper, and Italian herbs.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and sear chicken for 5 minutes per side until golden.
Remove chicken; add minced garlic, sun-dried tomatoes, and chicken broth to the skillet.
Pour in heavy cream and bring to a gentle simmer for 3 minutes.
Stir in baby spinach and parmesan cheese until wilted and creamy.
Return chicken to the sauce, spoon sauce over, and simmer for 2 more minutes. Serve warm!
author: Chef Subash

title: Artisan Neapolitan Margherita Pizza
ingredients: 250g pizza dough (flour, yeast, water, olive oil)
1/2 cup San Marzano crushed tomato sauce
steps: Preheat oven with a pizza stone at 250°C (480°F) for at least 30 minutes.
Stretch dough gently by hand on a floured surface to form a 10-inch round crust.
Spread tomato sauce evenly, leaving a 1-inch border for the crust.
Distribute mozzarella slices and drizzle with extra virgin olive oil.
Bake for 8-10 minutes until the crust is blistered and cheese is bubbly.
Garnish with fresh basil leaves immediately upon removing from oven and slice.
author: Maria Rossi

title: Spicy Thai Basil Fried Rice (Pad Krapow)
ingredients: 2-3 Thai bird's eye chilies, finely chopped
1 cup fresh holy basil or Thai basil leaves
steps: Pound chilies and garlic in a mortar and pestle into a coarse paste.
Heat wok with 2 tbsp oil on high; add garlic-chili paste and stir-fry for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add minced chicken, break apart and cook until browned (about 3 minutes).
Add oyster sauce, soy sauce, and dark soy sauce, stirring vigorously.
Add chilled cooked rice and toss vigorously on high heat for 2 minutes.
Turn off the heat, immediately fold in basil leaves until wilted, and top with a crispy fried egg.
author: Somchai K.

title: Japanese Fluffy Soufflé Pancakes
ingredients: 2 large eggs, separated into yolks and whites
Maple syrup and fresh berries for serving
steps: In a small bowl, whisk egg yolks with milk and vanilla until frothy. Sift in flour and baking powder, whisk smooth.
In a clean bowl, beat egg whites while gradually adding sugar until firm glossy peaks form.
Gently fold 1/3 of meringue into yolk batter, then carefully fold in the remaining meringue without deflating.
Grease a non-stick pan on very low heat. Scoop high dollops of batter onto pan, add a few drops of water, and cover with lid for 4 minutes.
Carefully flip pancakes, add a splash of water, cover, and steam for another 3 minutes.
Serve immediately stacked high with powdered sugar, butter, and maple syrup.
author: Yuki Tanaka

title: Classic Roman Carbonara
steps: Boil water with a moderate pinch of salt; cook pasta until al dente.
In a bowl, whisk eggs, egg yolks, and grated pecorino cheese with cracked black pepper into a thick cream.
In a deep pan, render guanciale on medium heat until golden and crispy. Turn off flame.
Transfer pasta directly into the pan with guanciale and toss to coat in rendered fat.
Let the pan cool for 30 seconds so eggs don't scramble, then pour in egg cheese mixture with 3 tbsp pasta water.
Vigorously stir until a silky glossy emulsion coats every piece of pasta. Serve with extra pecorino!
author: Chef Antonio

title: Avocado & Poached Egg Sourdough Toast
ingredients: Chili flakes and flaky sea salt
1 tbsp distilled white vinegar for poaching
Microgreens or fresh cilantro for garnish
steps: Toast sourdough slices until crunchy and golden brown.
Mash avocado with lemon juice, salt, and black pepper, keeping some texture.
Bring water with vinegar to a gentle simmer. Create a gentle whirlpool and slip in the eggs; poach for 3 minutes.
Generously spread avocado mash over toasted sourdough.
Lift poached eggs with a slotted spoon, blot on paper towel, and place on avocado toast.
Season with flaky sea salt, crushed red pepper flakes, and microgreens. Enjoy immediately!
author: Emma Watson
